title: Bring index builds under the ledger lock
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: `task next --from-index` (src/cli/index.ts:90-98), the `reindex` command (src/cli/index.ts:684), and POST /api/reindex (src/dashboard/server.ts:614) build `index.sqlite` WITHOUT acquiring the ledger lock, while `syncLedger` (src/core/sync.ts:75) builds it under the lock. Two concurrent index builders can hit SQLite busy/lock states or interleave DROP/CREATE. The index is disposable and rebuildable, so decide and implement: build index writes under `withLedgerLock`, or document and test the disposable-index concurrency contract explicitly.
acceptance: Concurrent index builds (e.g. two `reindex` processes) do not corrupt or error on SQLite lock states, OR the behavior is explicitly documented and tested as acceptable.
`reindex` from CLI/dashboard behaves identically to the locked path in `syncLedger`.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
notes:
Reported as audit finding #8 (low). Scope: index.sqlite is excluded from canonical state, so the fix may be documentation + a concurrency test rather than locking.

2026-10-18 reconciliation: implementation already landed in 0527560. Current source and existing acceptance regressions reviewed; 484 Bun tests, typecheck, Biome and ledger validation passed on the integrated release. See docs/audit-integration-2026-10-18.md.
